calls.title: Coreen Wilson and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book is currently focused on scaling its sales and marketing efforts to capitalize on its proven product-market fit, with 1,300 account signups per month and 120 enterprise customers generating $8 million in revenue this fiscal year. Following a $20 million funding raise in January, the company plans to build an aggressive sales strategy, aiming to more than double its revenue next year. With a team of around 30 employees, Growth Book differentiates itself through deep integration of experimentation in customer products, appealing particularly to regulated industries. The company is also working to broaden its target market by engaging product managers and other roles beyond engineers, while seeking a developer-savvy product marketer to refine messaging and connect with customers more effectively.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Product Marketing, Experimentation Platform, Developer-first, Pricing Model, Customer Data Ownership

calls.title: Coreen Wilson and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Coreen Wilson discussed her extensive experience in product marketing, emphasizing the necessity of clear, customer-focused messaging to navigate the complexities of technical markets. Her tenure at Progress Software highlighted challenges in converting interest into sales due to overly complex offerings, while her success at Carbon Black demonstrated how verticalized messaging generated significant revenue by addressing compliance needs. Coreen advocated for value-driven communication over feature-centric narratives, illustrated by her impressive lead generation from the "State of Agile" report at Digital AI. Additionally, her pricing strategies at Rapid7 and other companies focused on aligning pricing models with customer usage, ensuring competitive positioning. Throughout the conversation, Coreen's leadership style and cultural fit with Growth Book were underscored, showcasing her capability to drive strategic impact in a dynamic environment.
calls.keywords: Product Marketing, Platform Messaging, Verticalization, Pricing Strategy, Agile Report, Developer Engagement
